trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum lands on its own when the last of them does.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission— the first trophy of the game.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 1.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 2— the asterisks are in the official name, exactly as PlayStation publishes it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child’s Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown, at Vice City International Airport.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion on the in-game checklist— the long gold, and the last gate before the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts— stunt jumps scattered across Leonida, far more of them than the trophy needs.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once— a sampler, not a grind.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location that offers one.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races— repeats of the same race do not stack.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game— any cabinet, start to finish.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy’s whole stranger chain, through its final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton’s whole stranger chain, through its final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy’s whole stranger chain, through its final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy’s whole stranger chain, through its final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone’s whole stranger chain, through its final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations, with both Jason and Lucia— each spot counts twice that way. Start in Chapter 1: the first spot is a one-time offer that vanishes with the chapter.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations— scan the world with the WAiNK app as you travel.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges— the game’s tracked side-objectives.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you and escape the heat.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level in between.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles— variety, not mileage, is the grind.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA— leave the airport in a plane that was never yours.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: no source we read has a verified method— the description only hints at Rhinos, the game’s tanks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape— the crime list’s silver.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida— uncover the whole map, county by county.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach— a quiet moment, available early.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style— through the glass, in a car.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley— bowl a proper game there.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal— a two-lead feat whose exact trigger guides are still pinning down.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse)— a story-choice trophy; make your choices deliberately.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time’s the charm— a feat shaped like a retry: fail once, succeed on the second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: “What the hell just happened?”— a hidden oddity no source has verified a trigger for.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl ’em over with a melee drive-by— the name is the count and the method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
